summary: Barclays PLC furnished a routine Form 6-K disclosing an ordinary PDMR share transaction under UK Market Abuse Regulation. Craig Bright, Group Co-Chief Operating Officer, sold 65,500 ordinary shares at 4.873 pence... actually 4.873 GBP per share via Computershare as nominee administrator on 2026-09-09 on the London Stock Exchange. No stake percentage, premium, adviser, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are stated. This is a routine insider-dealing notification, not a special situation. What to watch: subsequent PDMR filings for any change in executive ownership or departure.
